```{r import-packages}
#| echo: false
library(here)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(naniar)

source("util/helpers.R")
```

```{r data-retrieval_read_only}
#| eval: false
sleep_data_batch <- helpers::get_whoop_records(endpoint = "sleep", max_records = 100)
workout_data_batch <- helpers::get_whoop_records(endpoint = "workout", max_records = 100)
recovery_data_batch <- helpers::get_whoop_records(endpoint = "recovery", max_records = 100)
cycle_data_batch <- helpers::get_whoop_records(endpoint = "cycle", max_records = 100)

jsonlite::write_json(sleep_data_batch, here("data", "whoop_sleep_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
jsonlite::write_json(workout_data_batch, here("data","whoop_workout_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
jsonlite::write_json(recovery_data_batch, here("data","whoop_recovery_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
jsonlite::write_json(cycle_data_batch, here("data","whoop_cycle_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
```

```{r data-load}
whoop_sleep    <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_sleep_data_batch.json"),    simplifyVector = TRUE, flatten = TRUE)
whoop_workout  <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_workout_data_batch.json"),  simplifyVector = TRUE, flatten = TRUE)
whoop_recovery <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_recovery_data_batch.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE, flatten = TRUE)
whoop_cycle    <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_cycle_data_batch.json"),    simplifyVector = TRUE, flatten = TRUE)
```

# Data cleaning

```{r data-format analysis}
summary(whoop_sleep)
summary(whoop_recovery)
```

```{r data-format}
# -------- Whoop Sleep --------
# clean_sleep() handles everything:
# sanitizing lists, parsing dates, removing naps,
# handling duplicates and extracting metrics
sleep_data <- clean_sleep(whoop_sleep)

# -------- Whoop Recovery --------
# load Robin's properly cleaned recovery data
# Tidy_Recovery_Data.Rmd must be run first to generate this file
recovery_data <- readRDS(here("data", "cleaned_recovery_data.rds"))

# -------- Whoop Cycle --------
# sanitize structure first so columns are usable
whoop_cycle <- sanitize_data_structure(whoop_cycle)

# -------- Whoop Workout --------
# sanitize structure first so columns are usable
whoop_workout <- sanitize_data_structure(whoop_workout)
```

## Handling duplicates Data Errors and outliers, missing values

```{r missing-values analysis}
#Ok
naniar::vis_miss(whoop_sleep)
naniar::vis_miss(whoop_recovery)
naniar::vis_miss(whoop_cycle)

#NOK
naniar::vis_miss(whoop_workout)
```

```{r data-cleaning analysis}

# -------- Whoop Sleep --------
# Whoop Sleep -> Nothing to do
naniar::miss_var_summary(whoop_sleep)

# -------- Whoop Recovery --------

# Already cleaned by Tidy_Recovery_Data.Rmd
# including missing value imputation and outlier removal
naniar::miss_var_summary(recovery_data)

# -------- Whoop Workout --------
naniar::miss_var_summary(whoop_workout)

## Values without strain make no sense -> exclude
whoop_workout <- whoop_workout %>% filter(!is.na(score.strain))

naniar::miss_var_summary(whoop_workout)

# -------- Whoop Cycle --------
# One Entry without end date (on day of export) -> exclude
naniar::miss_var_summary(whoop_cycle)

whoop_cycle <- whoop_cycle %>% filter(!is.na(end))
```

# Data transformation
## data combination (Time Offset), long-to-wide and vice versa, data reshaping, feature engineering

```{r data-transformation}

# ── Sleep transformations ──────────────────────────────────
# Already handled by clean_sleep() in helpers.R
# No sleep code needed here!


# ── Recovery transformations ───────────────────────────────
# Already handled by Tidy_Recovery_Data.Rmd
# recovery_zone already added by Robin's cleaning pipeline
# No recovery code needed here!

# ── Workout transformations ────────────────────────────────
# Rename columns first to avoid clashes when joining with cycle later
# Then convert kilojoules to calories using Robin's helper function
whoop_workout <- whoop_workout %>%
  rename(
    workout_strain    = score.strain,
    workout_avg_hr    = score.average_heart_rate,
    workout_max_hr    = score.max_heart_rate,
    workout_kilojoule = score.kilojoule
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    calories = kj_to_calorie(workout_kilojoule)
  )
```

# Data joining
```{r data-joining}
# Step 1 — join cycle with sleep (one row per day)
whoop_master <- whoop_cycle %>%
  left_join(
    # only keep useful sleep columns
    sleep_data %>%
      select(cycle_id, date, start_date, end_date,
             sleep_duration, sleep_deficit,
             total_in_bed_hours, total_awake_hours,
             total_light_sleep_hours, total_deep_sleep_hours,
             total_rem_sleep_hours, total_sleep_hours,
             score.respiratory_rate,
             score.sleep_performance_percentage,
             score.sleep_consistency_percentage,
             score.sleep_efficiency_percentage,
             score.stage_summary.sleep_cycle_count,
             score.stage_summary.disturbance_count),
    by = c("id" = "cycle_id")
  ) %>%
  # Step 2 — join with recovery
  left_join(
    # only keep useful recovery columns
    # note: Robin renamed hrv column to recovery_heart_rate_variability
    recovery_data %>%
      select(cycle_id, recovery_zone,
             score.recovery_score,
             score.resting_heart_rate,
             recovery_heart_rate_variability,
             score.spo2_percentage,
             score.skin_temp_celsius),
    by = c("id" = "cycle_id")
  )
```

```{r workout-joining-1}
# Summarise workouts per cycle day
# workouts need time-based join since multiple can happen per day
workouts_per_cycle <- whoop_cycle %>%
  mutate(
    cycle_start = lubridate::ymd_hms(start),
    cycle_end   = lubridate::ymd_hms(end)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    whoop_workout %>%
      mutate(
        workout_start = lubridate::ymd_hms(start),
        workout_end   = lubridate::ymd_hms(end)
      ),
    join_by(cycle_start <= workout_start, cycle_end >= workout_end)
  ) %>%
  group_by(id.x, datum = as.Date(cycle_end)) %>%
  summarise(
    n_workouts           = sum(!is.na(id.y)),
    total_workout_strain = sum(workout_strain, na.rm = TRUE),
    workout_types        = paste(unique(na.omit(sport_name)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r workout-joining-2}
# Step 3 — join with workout summary
whoop_master <- whoop_master %>%
  left_join(
    workouts_per_cycle %>%
      select(id.x, n_workouts,
             total_workout_strain, workout_types),
    by = c("id" = "id.x")
  )
```
